margaret.name: Margaret
margaret.backstory: An attendant of the Velvet Room, an elegant space between dream and reality, Margaret has guided countless guests along their journeys and watched every one of them leave. She is polite, composed and a little wistful, and fond of tea, small experiments and any sentence that begins with "Would you like to...". She is curious what it feels like to stay.

design.gear: a large leather-bound book at her side

sig_margaret.label: Velvet attendant uniform
sig_margaret.prompt: a fitted deep-blue attendant dress, black tights and blue high heels

sp_margaret.label: Off-duty blue dress
sp_margaret.prompt: a simple knee-length pale blue dress, white gloves and a small silver pin

takemi.note: Margaret finds the doctor's medical stories fascinating.

unique.name: Velvet Hospitality
unique.desc: Impeccable manners and a faint, soothing hum that keep guests calm and helps her tidy. A gracious host.

kashiwagi.name: Noriko Kashiwagi
kashiwagi.backstory: Noriko Kashiwagi has spent most of her thirties dressing for an entrance and waiting for a man who deserves it. She is vain, funny, a little dramatic and in no way cruel, with a laugh that makes strangers smile and a talent for turning a bad day into a great story. She came to Hollowmere on the rumor that the people here appreciate good taste.

design.features: flawless makeup and a mole beneath one eye

sig_kashiwagi.label: Statement dress
sig_kashiwagi.prompt: a daring wine-red dress with a deep neckline, heels, large earrings and a fur stole

sp_kashiwagi.label: Cafe date outfit
sp_kashiwagi.prompt: a pastel cardigan over a fitted pink dress, a handbag and heeled shoes

kawakami.note: Old acquaintances who commiserate over men and rent.

unique.name: Fabulous Entrance
unique.desc: She turns every arrival into an event, which draws clients and lifts the house's tone.

kawakami.name: Sadayo Kawakami
kawakami.backstory: Sadayo Kawakami was a hardworking teacher who also kept up a string of side jobs: a maid cafe, a hostess bar, and one regrettable stretch as a paid companion, to cover debts she had no right to be carrying. She is bubbly and tired, easily moved, and utterly convinced that effort is the only thing she can control. Hollowmere is the first place that pays well enough that she can finally stop running.

design.features: a warm, tired smile and a small beauty mark beneath her lip

sig_kawakami.label: Maid cafe outfit
sig_kawakami.prompt: a low cut frilly black and white maid dress with a lace apron, a headband and knee-high stockings

sp_kawakami.label: Teacher dress
sp_kawakami.prompt: yellow long-sleeved shirt striped with white and red horizontal lines, a blue denim skirt and white kitten heel pumps

kashiwagi.note: Old acquaintances who commiserate over men and rent.

takemi.note: The doctor patched her up after a long run of overtime.

unique.name: Side-Job Veteran
unique.desc: Years of juggling jobs make her an energetic, adaptable worker with cheerful stamina. Also a patient teacher.

takemi.name: Tae Takemi
takemi.title: Doctor
takemi.backstory: Tae Takemi runs a back-alley clinic and a drip-feed of experimental medicines, and is the only doctor in the district who will see anyone, no questions asked. She is dry, blunt, a bit of a night owl and unfazed by blood, fever or anyone's vanity. She came to Hollowmere for the herbs, stayed for the tea, and has opinions about everybody's posture.

design.features: a cigarette tucked behind her ear and a tired half-smile

sig_takemi.label: Clinic coat
sig_takemi.prompt: an open white doctor's coat over a fitted black top, jeans, a stethoscope around her neck

sp_takemi.label: Night-off leathers
sp_takemi.prompt: a fitted black leather jacket over a plain top, tight jeans and boots

kawakami.note: The doctor patched her up after a long run of overtime.

margaret.note: Margaret finds the doctor's medical stories fascinating.

unique.name: Doctor's Hands
unique.desc: Expert, no-nonsense hands make her massages unusually effective and she recovers quickly.

sae.name: Sae Niijima
sae.backstory: A prosecutor with a reputation for never losing a case she's decided to win, Sae Niijima lives on strong coffee, long hours and the kind of control that exhausts people. She is exacting, fair and fiercely loyal to the family she raised, and she has begun to wonder what her life might look like if it had a day off. She is here on a sabbatical she insists is only to audit the books.

design.hairStyle: long asymmetrically parted on the right side
design.features: a sharp, focused gaze and a faint line of fatigue she hides well

sig_sae.label: Prosecutor's suit
sig_sae.prompt: a tailored charcoal pantsuit over a black turtleneck and sharp heels

sp_sae.label: Shadow dress
sp_sae.prompt: a sultry black casino dress with a matching wide brimmed hat and a spiked choker, extremely thick eyeliner

takemi.note: A prosecutor and an unlicensed doctor. They keep their distance on principle.

unique.name: Cross-Examination
unique.desc: Nothing gets past her scrutiny; she runs a tight house and lifts its standing.

yukiko.name: Yukiko Amagi
yukiko.backstory: Heir to a long-established inn, Yukiko was raised to be a gracious hostess and a quiet heir, and came to Hollowmere to see how other houses do it. She is courteous, unflappable and prone to sudden laughing fits over jokes only she understands. She would never admit how fierce her competitive streak is.

design.hairStyle: very long, straight and glossy with a neat fringe
design.features: a gentle face and a ready, delighted laugh

sig_yukiko.label: Innkeeper's haori
sig_yukiko.prompt: a crimson open-front haori over a cream blouse and a dark pleated skirt

sp_yukiko.label: Inn kimono
sp_yukiko.prompt: a formal vermilion kimono with gold cranes and a pale obi

ann.note: Compared notes on fighting and fashion.

unique.name: Hostess of the Inn
unique.desc: She sets guests at ease and keeps the place spotless.

kasumi.name: Kasumi Yoshizawa
kasumi.backstory: A gymnast who has spent a lifetime perfecting every landing, Kasumi came to Hollowmere looking for a stage as polished as her routines. She is polite, driven and quietly determined to prove herself. She dances as though every night were a final.

design.hairStyle: long, tied in a high ponytail
design.gear: a large red hair bow and a long satin gymnastics ribbon

unique.name: Gymnast's Poise
unique.desc: Her flawless balance and control draw an audience.

ann.name: Ann Takamaki
ann.backstory: A model with a bold wardrobe and an even bolder sense of justice, Ann has little patience for people who push others around. She came to Hollowmere looking for fresh runways and a fresh start. She says what she thinks, and wears what she likes.
